spexr.$steps-note: spexr hand-tunes its indigo hover/active/subtle: the DS default derivation ratios (calibrated on amber) reproduce indigo hover within Δ1.3 but shift active/light Δ16–27, so the tuned steps stay explicit. Registered here (not blessed) because they ARE spexr's accent — the audit allowlists a product's registry colours. Kept in sync with themes/spexr-overrides.css.
spexr.$fill-note: spexr's filled primary is ONE deeper indigo on both themes, so its white label reads (5.41:1); the accent above still drives links, tags and the focus ring. Hover and active are not registered: they derive from the fill with the kit's one step (components.css --_sl-step-hover / -press), 0.05 / 0.10 of oklch lightness away from its white label, on both themes (owner, 2026-10-02: less is more): #424ccd / #3841b1, white on them 6.67 / 8.21 (until ui-kit 0.32.1 the mixes color-mix(in srgb, <fill> 89% / 76%, black), #444ecf / #3a43b1, 6.47 / 8.03).

local-agents.$steps-note: local-agents derives its accent tints via color-mix(var(--sl-accent-default) …) — the coder-blue base matches the pre-adoption rgb() literals exactly, so no tuned steps are registered. The two solid btn-p-hover blues (#1854bf/#79b8ff) and the inline-code fg (#1247a8/#79c0ff) are blessed in blessed/local-agents.json, not registered, because they are one-off tuned literals rather than the hover/active/subtle contract.
